design: all 48 heldout systems, seeds 1-2 on 8 compressible systems (G), shared fits on 2 implementation groups and 3 unrelated pairs with leave-one-implementation-out fits for both
eligibility_rule: PROTOCOL.md section 9: at most 10 % of fits and evaluations fail
ineligible_reason: independent-only by design: their shared and leave-one-out fits (18) count as failures, just above 10 % of 172
sensitivity_note: treating unsupported sharing as untestable instead of failed (PROTOCOL.md section 7) leaves the first candidate (lin_subspace) and the comparator baseline (lin_falds) unchanged
sharing_finding: no candidate obtains support for either implementation group: shared models are worse than independent ones and encoder-only adaptation rarely beats from-scratch fits
